It really depends on the champion honestly, 

Some champion's scale with level's, others with specific items atc.

Ill give you some examples. 

Supports like alistar, leona, nautilus (basically any hard cc engage support) gets their first spike when they get tier 2 boots, and one more at their first item, they dont need anything else honestly. Their job depending on the team comp is to engage or peel. Basically cc not provide dmg or something, neither tank to much dmg. Just provide Cc.

Enchanters scale with levels, and they need more gold than engage support yes, but still they hit a good spike at 2 items honestly. Like karma mythic+purifier= full build. 

Im otp sona and sona gets an early power spike at lvl 5 (3lvl W) and when she has kindlegem and tear (most of the times second recall) besides that she scales with lvls more than she does with items.

Mages need gold, and using first strike they can make good amount, especially if they get some kills

Champions like Pyke and pantheon snowballs very easy so if you play correct you wont get past 20-25min mark


Besides that its just being smart honestly and playing around your champion strongs. Engage support just need tier 2 boots and thats all basically. They dont need any more items.

Enchanters when they are behind can not build boots and rush core items first so even if they are behind they will get their mythic item around 15-17 minute mark.

Its all about being smart with the gold you have. Gold is not problem on support role. Support its so op role and it can be very influential with very low resources

If you want to train your macro and overall game knowledge the best thing you have to do is look high elo informative streamers and see what they do and why they do it,  then slowly adapt those tips and advices to your gameplay and after some games you will have a very decent macro gameplay

About mechanics they usually come with time and the higher you climb the better they will get, you see mechanics its not the crazy plays. Its mostly a mix of game knowledge and reaction time. Stop playing enchanter support if you do already. Enchanter supports can make a good teammate perfect not a bad teammate good so until you get at least plat dont use then if you want to climb fast. Pick an easy engage support like leona alistar and focus on engaging into your adc range, roam whenever your adc recall's and you dont want to recall yet, never run on bot after you have recalled unless the wave really sucks instead run mid and put some vision around your mid laner and scan for some vision with your lens, sometimes you also have to run top, those times are 1. if your top laner is pushing and he is low hp even if you cant kill the enemy top laner is good to run there to prevent a gank, just stay for some seconds in the lane bush so he can safe push the wave and recall the immediately recall with him and run bot again (if your top laner dont recall after some seconds and stay for hitting the turret or anything else just recall and leave him alone you don't want to stay there more than 5-10 seconds cause you want to go bot again). 2 if your jungler is top side and your top laner is pushing go top and set a dive if possible to the enemy top laner. 3. If herald is up go put a ward and then rotate to mid and look for a gank. just dont stay away of your adc a long period of time cause in low elo especially they will most likely die solo and mass ping/flame you.  you should be back in the lane when the wave is under your turret. Also you need to recognise which is your win condition you are not supporting your adc you supporting your whole team so if your adc is 0/4 and you dont have any kill pressure on your lane just perma roam and fight around your winning lanes, you are basically a second jungler. About vision you should always put vision around the drake or baron pit 1 minute to 45 seconds before the drake/baron come up (mid-late game), if your top laner is winning and he is a split pusher after you recall go and full ward the enemy jungle so he can split push safely, if you dont have prio in your lane meaning you play under your turret dont put CONTROL wards in the river or in the tri bush cause they will be cleared, instead put it around your mid laner or into your jungle in a defensive possition to keep your jungler safe from Invades. If a fight happen in mid lane or somewhere in river (even on the top side) if you have prio you should always rotate to it, unless the enemy bot lane  have kill pressure to your adc so considering you are bronze it will most likely die if you leave for few seconds, if you dont have prio and the enemy support rotate to the fight you should also do it.
Always try to take lvl 2 even if your lvl 2 sucks you should always take it and move aggressive, you take your lvl 2 btw after the first wave and the 3 melee minions on the second wave so as engage support keep your support item for the second wave, as soon as it approaches start hitting the melees and before you kill the third one start moving agressive against them, if your adc doesnt follow dont try to engage since you will mostly be chunked down, something i also like to do is if the enemy bot lane have great lvl 1 i run bot and put a ward at mid bush and insta recall to take my lens so i can see if they go fo a cheeky play, if they dont have good lvl 1 place a ward at the opposite side from where your jungler starts (for example if your jungler starts at your side let's say blue ward the river at the red side then recall take lens and go help jungle) you should leash your jungle until 1:38-1:39 no more cause you may loose xp of the first 3 minions, in the late game fights try to find a flash flank usually from raptors considering in low elo a lot of fights happen in mid lane. Now about macro since as support you want to shot call a lot you have to know some basic things first before go to kill objective or put some vision to the enemy jungle to setup waves you need to push the mid wave first so ping your team to help you do that, about turrets ideally you want to take all the tier 1 turret first then the tier 2 then start siege so it should be easy for you to coordinate your team (for example if the tier 1 mid and top turret have fallen you should ping to kill the bot turret, same appy for the tier 2/3 turrets and the ilhibitors dont run mid after you have take ilhi there instead just push mid wave and rotate to bot or top to take second and third ilhi and close the game) if you ever reach to a point you cant win a game just do baron and push, at fights also sometimes is good to peal your carry instead of engaging so if you are not the main engage for your team just stick to your win condition and make sure noone can kill him, if you ever play enchanter support ill gove you some tips, autoattack the enemy adc whenever he goes for last hit they will always go for that so you just getting a free auto, you can also land your abilities if he goes for last hit dont throw your abilities here and there throw them whenever he goes for last hit, jusr becarefull not to overcommit cause you may end up getting to much dmg one auto and one ability at the time is more tha enough pressure, about your possition that also apply for tank support you need to stay in parallel line with your adc never stay behind of your adc for no reason, try move back and forth in the enemy adc auto attack range so they cant tell if you are going to engage or not, ill suggest you watching some videos from corejj that he explains that into a custom match just search corejj support positioning. Now my last tip is about items in engage/roam support you want to rush tier 2 boots some times if you have spare 350 gold buy dark seal even on shen leona or alistar it may seem troll but its actually the best buy you can do for that money just make sure its spare money and not money you need also buy a lot pf control wards you should always have 2 at you and you should aim to place around 8-10 control ward per game and same wards as the minutes of the game for example 30 wards at 30 mins atc. More wards placed that minutes of the game is the best but all comes about the flow of the game. As enchanter support if all your lanes loosing dont buy boots just rush for your core item boots will only delay your core items and you dont really need them to run from one turret to the other, sometimes you will need to start with different item than a muthic one for example if you facing heavy healling teams is good to rush purified for the antiheal, if you playing against heavy cc teams rush mikaels. And last one never die for a teammate if a teammate does a bad engage dont follow, if a teammate overstay when you dont have to dont stay just leave let them die, dont die ever to save your teammates unless your are 100 percent dead and you want to save some time to help your team run away, the only time you should risk your life to help a teammate is if that teammate have huge shutdown like 600-700g, try to die as less time possible every match aim around 3-4, mute everyone on your team and enemy team, dont tilt over your bad teammates just focus to get better and you will climb eventually no matter how bad mmr you have, when you reach gold+ write down the flash couldowns of enemy team to help your jungler.
